findings.evidence: The any-current early return prevents remaining tail routes from reaching delivery. Worker reclamation passes only completed siblings, but guarded replay requires the original complete owner inventory; a partial two-route completion can retry that incompatible subset forever. Preserve the original coordinated inventory while resuming incomplete required routes.

CompletedOriginal rejects every superseded item with reservation tokens. Tail delivery chooses the newer observed head once active row reservations clear; scheduler deletion can fail after that completed reservation, so the old durable item survives and can never settle. This differs from R1-E2 unreserved settlement: retain exact original scoped completion/private-cleanup proof or prevent overtaking until the reserved original is reclaimed; sequence alone is insufficient.

IsValid accepts any lowercase 64-hex digest at head zero; actor inspection and the existing-proof bootstrap branch return Available for it. IsQualifiedEmpty separately compares the deterministic seed, confirming the missing invariant. Validate the zero-head source-v1 seed consistently before reporting Available or reusing that proof.

Every unknown property allocates its name and a capturing FindIndex predicate and repeatedly converts known names. The actual owning-store probe reports 73444856 cumulative allocated bytes for a valid 855999-byte H=10000 row with 50000 unknown siblings; a 5-million-character name also allocates before the absolute cap. This establishes material allocation/CPU pressure, not a measured peak-live 4S violation. Match cached known names without per-unknown allocations while preserving configured naming/case/escape semantics and schema1 compatibility.

The guarded preflight does not bound digest cardinality/type against the admitted row. An actual owning read materializes 160000 null digests in an 853229-byte H=10000 body before later identity rejection; its compact byte array alone is 5120000 bytes, over 4S=3789824, before the malformed dictionary. The probe reports 23129456 cumulative allocation. Reject impossible guarded evidence before typed graph materialization; retain accepted schema1/legacy representations without truncation.
